messages:
maria: Quick preflight — we're still on for 2026-03-24 20:00 UTC deploy. Can owners confirm rollback paths + who's flipping the safety toggle? I updated the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-2026-03-24

cheng: I'm on primary oncall for the window, I reviewed the runbook. Two quick items: DB schema not part of this release, right? Also confirm the healthcheck thresholds we'll use for canary.

maria: No schema changes — just model and routing config. Healthcheck during canary: 95% 1m success, 99% 5m for full. If canary falls below 90% 1m we abort. Added these to the runbook. :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll own the feature-flag flip and the escape-hatch. Rollback plan in practice: 1) disable feature flag, 2) scale down 1-step canary, 3) revert routing config, 4) restart affected pods. Command snippets in runbook.

jasmin: I'll run smoke tests post-deploy. Checklist I'll run (quick): login, baseline API samples, embedding sanity, downstream consumers. Posting results to #incidents if anything odd.

alex: One more: healthcheck change I mentioned in the PR will temporarily increase timeout to 5s for canary. Need to remember to set it back in the rollback path. Added a note in the runbook under "undo steps".

maria: Nice — calling out owners in the runbook now: feature-flag = @sam, smoke = @jasmin, monitor = @cheng, ops assist = @alex.

ops-bot: Scheduled deploy job created: deploy-2026-03-24-2000 (id: dj-48219). Watch logs at https://deploys.redwood.internal/dj-48219

cheng: Quick question about KV cache: if we rollback we should also clear prefix caches for the routing model. I added a short script to the runbook: `scripts/clear_kv_prefix.sh --model routing-v2`

sam: Confirmed. I'll run the clear script as part of rollback step 2. Also keeping a hot backup of the current routing config in S3 key s3://redwood-deploy-backups/routing-20260324.json

maria: Proposal: do a T-15 go/no-go check here in thread. If no blockers by 19:45 UTC we'll proceed. Anyone raising a blocker?

jasmin: No blockers from QA, smoke tests are green on staging. :thumbsup:

alex: OK from infra side, I've got a watch on autoscaler policies.

cheng: Ready on monitoring + alerts. I've set the PagerDuty escalation to include @cheng and @alex for this window.

sam: I'll be on the call and will flip flag. +1

maria: Great — go/no-go: proceed unless someone objects by 19:45 UTC. I'll post final confirmation T-15. Thanks all. :rocket:
